item.title: Iran crisis exposes the impotence of America’s Neoliberal War Machine
item.description: Could the stark choice our country is facing in Iran be a turning point, a moment when the American people will stand up and clearly, strongly say “No” to war, before our corrupt leaders can plunge Iran?

item.title: House vote battle intensifies as bipartisan lawmakers seek to block Iran strikes without Congress
item.description: Khanna and Massie invoke constitutional authority amid reports of military buildup and rising concerns of expanded war.

item.title: Credit MAGA Trump for busting up federalism like a piñata, only to spotlight which robber barons seize the juiciest prizes
item.description: One imagined the durability, if not standing of America, demanded a far stronger, earth-shaking force than a self-mortifying, scamming joke.

item.title: Enough! Trump must be stopped. He’s turning America into the Pariah of the world
item.description: Use every power they have to make his actions useless and make him useless. This will work. It’s something Democrats have never done before. Now is the time!
